svg.text: Sale_Items and Purchase_Items are weak entities: a line has no identity of its own. It is identified by its owner (Sales / Purchases)
through the identifying relationship plus the partial key product_id, so the full key is (sale_id, product_id) / (purchase_id, product_id).
Double lines: every product has a category and a supplier, every sale a customer, every purchase a supplier, every line an owner and a
product, every ledger row a product (NOT NULL foreign keys). total_amount is derived: the triggers keep it equal to the sum of the lines.
